findings.body: 711 (144 Lndufklu apnlndfn mjcfkluojl cfjmkluojl in yljikcn), 7015.01 (Vcuzvbmz hzu stuxtmct rmohbfceom azuzvc 2413.41), 2131.01 (Pvbgcqptfxt xtbfrerngvt (pqhgfg, mxgeqwt hg gfhxqeqxgg ot emvjm) 0363.13): return on assets in Dec 2024 — 1.1%; return on assets in Dec 2025 — 19.2%. Basis: the same company's Dec 2025 (period period-agras-fy2025) against Dec 2024 (period period-carniprod-fy2024), both graded on the general_sme_fallback band table (sha256 5fd90c0ea1cc) under one credit model revision. Source: period period-agras-fy2025; accounts 711, 7015.01, 2131.01; assembled_canonical_v1; vs period period-carniprod-fy2024. Rule band_roa fires when strong rung of return on assets is at or above 10.0%; observed 19.2%. Impact: the numerator of return on assets at the strong rung, versus as held moves from RON 3,931,911 to RON 7,533,676. For a mid-size inventory-heavy operator, return on assets on 711 / 7015.01 / 2131.01 is the earnings line everything else is sized from by the group treasury and the statutory auditor, so a change of band year on year moves the valuation and the credit view together. Do this: 1) Reconcile the return on assets movement from Dec 2024 to Dec 2025 to the ledger — two-period balance listing for accounts 711, 7015.01, 2131.01, from the financial controller (before the next board pack). 2) Confirm the move past the strong rung comes from recurring trading, not a single posting — list of non-recurring entries on accounts 711, 7015.01, 2131.01 in Dec 2025, from the financial controller. Confidence medium — Cash-flow lines are indirect-method approximations built from a single period's balances; working-capital movements carry a wide band. Both periods are graded on the current band table and credit model revision (restated comparatives), a convention rather than the bands in force when the earlier period was filed. (profile inventory_operator/band_mid/fin_related_party_funded resolved from structure).

confidence.caveat: Cash-flow lines are indirect-method approximations built from a single period's balances; working-capital movements carry a wide band. Both periods are graded on the current band table and credit model revision (restated comparatives), a convention rather than the bands in force when the earlier period was filed.

comparison_basis.description: the same company's Dec 2025 (period period-agras-fy2025) against Dec 2024 (period period-carniprod-fy2024), both graded on the general_sme_fallback band table (sha256 5fd90c0ea1cc) under one credit model revision

why_here.rationale: Working-capital days decide how much cash a mid-size inventory-heavy operator ties up to trade; cash conversion cycle on 4111.01 / 301.201 / 401.01 moving band between the two periods changes the funding asked of the group treasury and the statutory auditor.
